The '''communication station''', also known as the '''comm station''', was a base of operations built by members of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[Chaleydonia/Legends|Chaleydonia]], in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].

==Description==
The communication station was built on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Christophsis">{{SWE|locations|christophsis|Christophsis}}</ref> [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[Chaleydonia/Legends|Chaleydonia]].<ref name="TCWn" /> It was utilized by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] during the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]] to coordinate transmissions in the ongoing battle, and was equipped with a [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]] to show an active [[Map/Legends|map]] of the battle.<ref name="TCWf" />

==History==
{{Quote|Cannon's not going to make a dent in [the shield generator], so I say we save our ordnance for later. In the meantime, all we can do is try to engage them in confined spaces."''<br />''"We'll draw them into the buildings, they've got to find us to fight us.|Jedi General Kenobi and Clone Captain Rex, discussing their strategy in the communication station|<ref name="TCWn" />}}
===Construction and usage===
During the Battle of Christophsis<ref name="TCWn" /> in [[22 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] used the station as a command center to plan a strike on a [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]] being used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] to give [[Confederacy military/Legends|its forces]] protection from the Republic's [[AV-7 Antivehicle Cannon/Legends|AV-7 cannons]] during the latter faction's assault on the [[City/Legends|city]].<ref name="TCWf" />

In the ensuing battle, the Confederacy forces overran the Republic lines, including the communication station, as the battle progressed. In the process, the communication station was heavily damaged and the Confederacy troops overwhelmed the Republic clones, and Kenobi was forced to order [[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]] "Rex" to retreat while he delayed the incoming [[Battle droid/Legends|droids]] in an attempt to buy time for the shield generator to be destroyed.<ref name="TCWjn">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (junior novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' junior novelization]]</ref>

===Aggressive negotiations===
Kenobi stood his ground against the oncoming battle droids and managed to eliminate numerous droids before being forced to surrender to Separatist [[General/Legends|General]] [[Whorm Loathsom/Legends]] in an attempt to buy time for Skywalker to destroy the shield generator. The negotiations ended with Kenobi holding his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to Loathsom's throat, forcing the latter's escort to hold their fire on the Jedi.

Shortly thereafter, the shield was destroyed by the combined efforts of Skywalker and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], the clone troopers surged forward to Kenobi's position and regained their former positions, fighting past the communication station and securing their victory over the Separatists. After the victory over the Confederacy forces, [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] convened with Kenobi at the communication station and proceeded to inform him of his next assignment.<ref name="TCWf" />

==Behind the scenes==
The communication station first appeared in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (junior novelization)|junior novelization]] of the [[2008]] film [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'']] by [[Tracey West]]<ref name="TCWjn" /> and simultaneously in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|adult novelization]] by [[Karen Traviss]] on [[July 26]] 2008.<ref name="TCWn" />
